task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Drop cloth placement per door location. ~5 min per door. Shared across doors in same room.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mask walls around door opening + extend floor protection. ~10 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Door Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove lockset + 3 hinges, bag and label. ~20 min per door. Per Doors Doctrine §10.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Door Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mask 3 hinges (~5 min each) + lockset (~5 min). ~20 min per door total.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Door Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection per door side. ~3 min per side. Marking defects.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Door Surface (Prep)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Scuff sand factory primer or full sand bare wood. ~7-8 min per side for standard flush door.

task_production_rates.name: Fill Fastener Holes
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fill 2-4 nail holes per side typical. ~2 min per side.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Filled Areas
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sand filler spots smooth. ~2 min per side.

task_production_rates.name: Seal MDF Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush shellac on exposed MDF edges. ~4 min per side (edges assigned to that side).

task_production_rates.name: Clean Sanding Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe. ~2 min per side.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray primer coat per door side. ~5 min per side including edges. Production pace.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Primer on Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush primer coat per door side. ~12 min per side. Slower than spray.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Coat (Interstage)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection between coats. QT3=quick glance ~2 min, QT4=systematic ~4 min, QT5=critical ~5 min.

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Between Coats
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: QT3=spot sand ~3 min, QT4=full sand 220 ~8 min, QT5=thorough 320 ~10 min per side.

task_production_rates.name: Patch/Repair Defects (Interstage)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spot patch defects found during interstage inspection. ~3 min per side average.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Interstage)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe between coats. ~2 min per side.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Finish Coat on Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray finish coat per door side. ~6 min per side. Slightly slower than primer for quality finish. Flush door baseline.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Finish Coat on Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush finish coat per door side. ~15 min per side. Flush door baseline.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Glass Panes (French)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mask one glass pane — tape all 4 edges precisely. ~6 min per pane.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Glass Masking (French)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove masking from one glass pane. ~3 min per pane.

task_production_rates.name: Final Door Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Final inspection per door side. QT3=~2 min, QT4=~4 min, QT5=~5 min.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall Door Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reinstall lockset + hinges, verify door operation. ~15 min per door. Per Doors Doctrine §10.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Hardware Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove masking tape from hinges and hardware. ~5 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove floor protection per door location. ~3 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed time: ~30-45 min per session regardless of door count. Modeled as flat allowance.

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard door painting — baseline for all rates
quality_tier_effects.notes: Standard NC production: scuff sand, 2 coats, spot sand between. Per Doors Doctrine QT3 labor factor = 1.0

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium door painting — thorough prep, full sand between coats, crisp edges
quality_tier_effects.notes: Per Doors Doctrine §6.1 QT4 labor factor = 1.4. Full sand 220 between coats. Systematic inspection.

quality_tier_effects.description: Superior door painting — maximum care, zero tolerance, 320-grit between coats
quality_tier_effects.notes: Per Doors Doctrine §6.1 QT5 labor factor = 1.8. Thorough sand 320 between coats. Critical inspection.

door_type_complexity.notes: 4-panel door. Detail work on panels, rails, stiles. Per Doors Doctrine §1.1.
6-panel door (colonial). More detail. Per Doors Doctrine §1.1.
French door. Glass masking is dominant labor component. 80-120% additional over flush. Per Doors Doctrine §9.2. Glass masking tracked separately by pane count.
Bifold door panel. Smaller panels, less SF per side. Track system differs from standard hinges. Per Doors Doctrine §1.1.
Louvered door. Extreme complexity — individual slat painting. 3 light coats instead of 2. Spray-only practical. Per Doors Doctrine §12.2 and brief acceptance criteria (2.5+).

door_size_effects.notes: Tall door. Slightly more area. May need step ladder for top.
Oversized door. Step ladder required. Per Doors Doctrine §9.2 overheight modifier +18-25%.

crew_configurations.name: Single Door Sprayer
crew_configurations.notes: One sprayer handles all doors. Helper for masking/protection setup.

crew_configurations.name: Single Door Brush Painter
crew_configurations.notes: One painter brushes doors. Can also do mini-roller for flush panels.
